Melyra® delivers advanced dual-action protection with the combined power of Revysol® and F 500®, Melyra targets two different fungal processes for stronger and reliable disease control. Revysol® inhibits ergosterol biosynthesis, weakening fungal cell membrane formation and F 500 targets fungal respiration by blocking mitochondrial energy production. Imunit‘s active ingredients eliminate pests in two ways:Firstly, Imunit works as a Chitin biosynthesis inhibitor, targets formation, weakening the exoskeleton. Without sturdy chitin, pests struggle to molt properly, disturbing their growth and ultimately leading to a slow death. Imunit attacks pests in two different ways from within ensuring effective pest control and a safe takeoff of your crop.
